This '''planetary defense cannon''' was located in a mountain range on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==History==
The cannon was capable of destroying entire enemy fleets. During the conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], teams of Sith and Jedi-led forces fought to take control of the cannon.
